entities.summary: Ragnar Ágúst Nathanaelsson is an Icelandic basketball player who plays for Álftanes. He participated at EuroBasket 2015 as a member of the Icelandic national team. He is a two time Úrvalsdeild Domestic All-First team selection and won the Icelandic Basketball Cup in 2022. Ragnar is the tallest living man in Iceland.
